'''H'Krav''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and member of the crew of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Null Space]]''. The ship was surrendered to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s to avoid being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the commander, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Obigon]].
